title: LINUXDRV-004: `relay_mutex` and `port_mutex` are initialized but never destroyed before the private data is freed
summary: LINUXDRV-004: `relay_mutex` and `port_mutex` are initialized but never destroyed before the private data is freed. This is unlikely to affect a single-process normal shutdown, but repeated driver load/unload cycles leak pthread mutex resources and complicate sanitizers. Destroy both mutexes during detach/delete after timers are cancelled and no callbacks can use them. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied. Current audit reconciliation: Current generated GPIO drivers no longer own historical relay_mutex/port_mutex members. Next: capture removed-ownership and current lifecycle checks for verified historical closure; not silently closed by this audit.

resolution.evidence: 20261025074335-0b62-fix-rpio-gpio-findings/findings.md; the generated aux_rpio and aux_asiair drivers own no relay_mutex/port_mutex and create no pthread mutex.
